metadata.question: On June 24, 2025, was New York City highest temperature higher than June 24, 2024?

data.raw_code: Looking at this question, I need to compare maximum temperatures in NYC on two specific future dates. This presents a challenge since satellite data doesn't exist for June 24, 2025 yet. 1. Search strategy: The question asks about June 24, 2025 (future date). No satellite data exists for future dates. Most datasets only go up to near-present (typically 1-3 months ago). Even reanalysis datasets like ERA5 don't have 2025 data yet. 2. Masking strategy: Temperature data typically doesn't require cloud masking for reanalysis products. 3. Logic: This will likely fail because 2025 data doesn't exist. We should check collection size and get C1 if empty. We'll try ERA5 which has temperature data but won't have 2025. Let me structure: - Use ERA5-Land daily aggregated data for air temperature - Define NYC point geometry - Check both collections (2024-06-24 and 2025-06-24) - Expect 2025 to be empty collection ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions nyc = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.0060, 40.7128]).buffer(5000) # 5km buffer around NYC date_2024 = '2024-06-24' date_2025 = '2025-06-24' # 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated (2m temperature) dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR' band = 'temperature_2m_max' # Get 2024 data col_2024 = ee.ImageCollection(dataset) \ .filterBounds(nyc) \ .filterDate(f'{date_2024}', ee.Date(f'{date_2024}').advance(1, 'day')) # Get 2025 data col_2025 = ee.ImageCollection(dataset) \ .filterBounds(nyc) \ .filterDate(f'{date_2025}', ee.Date(f'{date_2025}').advance(1, 'day')) # Check collection sizes size_2024 = col_2024.size().getInfo() size_2025 = col_2025.size().getInfo() print(f"2024 Images: {size_2024}") print(f"2025 Images: {size_2025}") # If either collection is empty, we can't compare if size_2024 == 0 or size_2025 == 0: # Try alternative dataset for missing year if size_2024 == 0: # Try MODIS for 2024 as alternative modis_2024 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') \ .filterBounds(nyc) \ .filterDate(f'{date_2024}', ee.Date(f'{date_2024}').advance(1, 'day')) if modis_2024.size().getInfo() == 0: print("C1") exit() else: # Use MODIS LST (convert from Kelvin to Celsius) img_2024 = modis_2024.first().select('LST_Day_1km') temp_2024 = img_2024.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.max(), geometry=nyc, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if temp_2024: temp_2024 = temp_2024 * 0.02 - 273.15 # Convert to Celsius else: temp_2024 = None if size_2025 == 0: # Try MODIS for 2025 (will fail as future date) modis_2025 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') \ .filterBounds(nyc) \ .filterDate(f'{date_2025}', ee.Date(f'{date_2025}').advance(1, 'day')) if modis_2025.size().getInfo() == 0: print("C1") exit() print("C1") exit() # 3. Process images (collections should have 1 image each for single day) img_2024 = col_2024.first().select(band) img_2025 = col_2025.first().select(band) # Check valid pixels count_2024 = img_2024.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=nyc, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(band).getInfo() count_2025 = img_2025.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=nyc, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(band).getInfo() print(f"2024 Valid pixels: {count_2024}") print(f"2025 Valid pixels: {count_2025}") if count_2024 == 0 or count_2025 == 0: print("C2") exit() # 4. Calculate max temperatures (ERA5 gives temperature in Kelvin) temp_2024 = img_2024.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.max(), geometry=nyc, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(band).getInfo() temp_2025 = img_2025.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.max(), geometry=nyc, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(band).getInfo() # Convert from Kelvin to Celsius if temp_2024 is not None: temp_2024 = temp_2024 - 273.15 if temp_2025 is not None: temp_2025 = temp_2025 - 273.15 print(f"2024 Max Temp: {temp_2024:.1f}°C") print(f"2025 Max Temp: {temp_2025:.1f}°C") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if temp_2024 is None or temp_2025 is None: print("C3") elif temp_2025 > temp_2024: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
nyc = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.0060, 40.7128]).buffer(5000)  # 5km buffer around NYC
date_2024 = '2024-06-24'
date_2025 = '2025-06-24'

# 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated (2m temperature)
dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR'
band = 'temperature_2m_max'

# Get 2024 data
col_2024 = ee.ImageCollection(dataset) \
    .filterBounds(nyc) \
    .filterDate(f'{date_2024}', ee.Date(f'{date_2024}').advance(1, 'day'))

# Get 2025 data  
col_2025 = ee.ImageCollection(dataset) \
    .filterBounds(nyc) \
    .filterDate(f'{date_2025}', ee.Date(f'{date_2025}').advance(1, 'day'))

# Check collection sizes
size_2024 = col_2024.size().getInfo()
size_2025 = col_2025.size().getInfo()

print(f"2024 Images: {size_2024}")
print(f"2025 Images: {size_2025}")

# If either collection is empty, we can't compare
if size_2024 == 0 or size_2025 == 0:
    # Try alternative dataset for missing year
    if size_2024 == 0:
        # Try MODIS for 2024 as alternative
        modis_2024 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') \
            .filterBounds(nyc) \
            .filterDate(f'{date_2024}', ee.Date(f'{date_2024}').advance(1, 'day'))
        if modis_2024.size().getInfo() == 0:
            print("<answer>C1</answer>")
            exit()
        else:
            # Use MODIS LST (convert from Kelvin to Celsius)
            img_2024 = modis_2024.first().select('LST_Day_1km')
            temp_2024 = img_2024.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.max(),
                geometry=nyc,
                scale=1000,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
            if temp_2024:
                temp_2024 = temp_2024 * 0.02 - 273.15  # Convert to Celsius
    else:
        temp_2024 = None
    
    if size_2025 == 0:
        # Try MODIS for 2025 (will fail as future date)
        modis_2025 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') \
            .filterBounds(nyc) \
            .filterDate(f'{date_2025}', ee.Date(f'{date_2025}').advance(1, 'day'))
        if modis_2025.size().getInfo() == 0:
            print("<answer>C1</answer>")
            exit()
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Process images (collections should have 1 image each for single day)
img_2024 = col_2024.first().select(band)
img_2025 = col_2025.first().select(band)

# Check valid pixels
count_2024 = img_2024.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=nyc,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get(band).getInfo()

count_2025 = img_2025.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=nyc,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get(band).getInfo()

print(f"2024 Valid pixels: {count_2024}")
print(f"2025 Valid pixels: {count_2025}")

if count_2024 == 0 or count_2025 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Calculate max temperatures (ERA5 gives temperature in Kelvin)
temp_2024 = img_2024.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.max(),
    geometry=nyc,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get(band).getInfo()

temp_2025 = img_2025.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.max(),
    geometry=nyc,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get(band).getInfo()

# Convert from Kelvin to Celsius
if temp_2024 is not None:
    temp_2024 = temp_2024 - 273.15
if temp_2025 is not None:
    temp_2025 = temp_2025 - 273.15

print(f"2024 Max Temp: {temp_2024:.1f}°C")
print(f"2025 Max Temp: {temp_2025:.1f}°C")

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
if temp_2024 is None or temp_2025 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif temp_2025 > temp_2024:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
